crossRefs.note: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
It was so, that when any man came near to bow down to him, he stretched out his hand, and took hold of him, and kissed…
All the people went over the Jordan, and the king went over. Then the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he…
Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

translations.web: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
translations.bsb: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
translations.kjv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
translations.asv: Thou gavest me no kiss: but she, since the time I came in, hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
